command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $script=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'fix_sidebar_artwork_format.py'; @'

from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(r"C:\dev\flyExplorer")

x=ROOT/"app/winui/NavigationSidebar.xaml"
s=x.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
s=s.replace("\\n", "\n")
x.write_text(s,encoding="utf-8",newline="")
print("FIXED_XAML_NEWLINES_AND_BOM")

cpp=ROOT/"app/winui/NavigationSidebar.xaml.cpp"
s=cpp.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

cpp.write_text(s,encoding="utf-8",newline="")
